content.label: program.subtitle
content.text: March 18–20 | Porto Congress Hall | Product systems, internal tooling, and operational design at scale.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Opening keynote: When internal tools become the business

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: A practical talk on why workflow software, reporting, and document systems stop being support code once they shape operational throughput.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Designing contracts for repeatable PDF systems

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: A session on replacing ad-hoc template edits with layout contracts, semantic tags, and deterministic pagination rules.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Panel: The hidden cost of brittle internal workflows

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: Operators from logistics, healthcare, and government discuss where formatting debt slows real work down.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Clinic: Pagination, grouping, and deterministic output rules

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: A hands-on walkthrough of the small rules that separate an attractive PDF demo from a reusable document system.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Workshop: Turning ops chaos into authorable systems

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: Participants map one messy operational workflow into a stable authoring contract with defined layout and content boundaries.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Case study: Building internal publishing rails for public-sector records

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: From accessibility tags to archival consistency, this talk covers why structured publishing now matters beyond mere appearance.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Roundtable: What should a document contract own?

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: Participants debate the boundary between content schema, styling system, renderer guarantees, and backend-specific implementation details.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Keynote: Governance patterns for internal platform contracts

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: How mature teams keep layout systems flexible without letting every new request become an unreviewed primitive.

children.label: program.slot.title
children.text: Maintaining a gallery of document systems without design drift

children.label: program.slot.meta
children.text: A practical session on examples, validation, review workflows, and how to keep your document library coherent as use cases multiply.

content.label: program.note
content.text: Evening roundtables begin at 18:00 on day two. Speaker office hours, one-on-one layout reviews, and sponsor lounges are available by registration only.
